system.description:
Animals like you far too much. Every night when you rise, they are waiting: a pack of creatures gathers from within roughly six miles of your resting place and follows you around, looking to you for leadership. They disperse while you sleep, only to regroup with the coming of night, and can give away the location of your haven or make it difficult to move about unnoticed if you linger anywhere for long.

Taken at two Traits, the animals drawn are small and easily overlooked, such as rats or mice. At three Traits, they are more noticeable, like cats. At four Traits, you are trailed by animals that are very hard to miss — wolves, bears or stags. The Storyteller and player should agree on the Flaw's Trait cost based on the type of animal drawn before play.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
